g.title: note2
g.text: IN1-IN3 commons return to TB-2 (0 V).
TB-4 is +15 V with active-high inputs (P120 = 2):
commons on TB-4 never conduct (fails safe as a drive fault).

g.title: note1
g.text: IN1/IN2: HIGH = limit actuated (NO contact closed)
IN3: HIGH = VFD healthy; LOW = fault/power loss/wire break
